title: Bent affine modulation
statement: Given a sign $[0m\sigma\in\{\pm1\}$, a vector $a$ in the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, and a real-valued function $f$ on that cube, define the modulated function at $x$ as the product of the sign, the Walsh character indexed by $a$ evaluated at $x$, and $f(x)$.
